secrets.name: NEON_API_KEY
secrets.description: Neon API key (Neon Console -> Account settings -> API keys, or `neonctl api-keys create`) used ONLY by the Neon CLI to deploy the Pact Neon Functions from this sandbox (`neonctl functions deploy <slug> ...`). The app does not read it at boot or at runtime. Enter the bare key with NO surrounding quotes — a quoted value is rejected verbatim by the Neon API.

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Hosted Neon Postgres connection string for the Pact Neon runtime (Neon console -> Project -> Connection string, or `neon connection-string --project-id <id> --branch main`). Include sslmode=require; the role must own the tables so the baseline's RLS deny policies do not block the app. Optional for local work: without it the api service falls back to the compose Postgres via .env.base44-defaults.

secrets.name: SESSION_HMAC_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC signing secret for wallet sessions (server-side only). Generated development placeholder; the app needs a real value for any shared environment.

secrets.name: AGENT_SIGNER_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Testnet private key of the Arc agent signer wallet that submits controller.pay (0x + 64 hex). Provision the address with `docker compose -f docker-compose.base44.yml exec -T api node scripts/create-wallet.mjs --role agent --label arc-agent-1`, fund it with gas on Arc testnet, then store its key here. Optional for boot: while absent the executor stays read-only and POST /v1/payments/execute never signs.

secrets.name: AGENT_SIGNER_KEYS
secrets.description: Multi-agent signer lane: a JSON map of {"0x<agent address>":"0x<64-hex private key>"} the agent-executor may sign controller.pay with, keyed by the agent each key is bound to. An entry is kept only when the key's derived address equals the declared agent. Supply the key controlling card 3's agent (0xfda82d8911f43a93b4d5d5ce9fffce4ad7f88435) to let the lane execute for card 3. Enter bare JSON with NO surrounding quotes; a single BARE 0x key is also accepted (2026-10-09) and binds to the one agent that key derives. Optional for boot: while absent the lane signs only with AGENT_SIGNER_PRIVATE_KEY.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI-gateway intent path (platform.openai.com). Without it POST /v1/agent/intents returns PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE while GET /health still answers 200.
